title: VictoryHoldBroken
description: The coalition's victory hold broke (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §9; ECONOMY EC-9; NX-412 part 4): its share of strategic nodes fell below campaign.victory_node_frac. With campaign.victory.hold_break decay the hold keeps progress_ticks and decays until it resumes (VictoryHoldStarted) or resets (VictoryHoldReset) (ECONOMY EC-9a, NX-489); with reset it keeps 0. Not emitted when the campaign ends during the hold. Public, like VictoryHoldStarted.

node_id.description: The hold node the coalition lost on this tick (the lowest id when it lost more than one).

progress_ticks.description: The progress the broken hold keeps (ECONOMY EC-9a): its running ticks credited so far with hold_break decay, 0 with reset.
